name: Wasos log -> Bridge log
info: Converts WaSOS chat messages to Bridge format. Maps content to text, createdAt to timeCreated, username to loggedByFullName and adds client identifier.

name: map Wasos log to Bridge log
info: Maps WaSOS message fields to Bridge format: content->text, createdAt->timeCreated (as timestamp), username->loggedByFullName. Adds wasos as client identifier.
